references.phrase: for every i exists j≥i for all k≥j
references.disposition: The stabilizing index may depend on i; equality is of images in A_i, not equality of transition maps.

review_rationale: Reviewed the full eventual-stabilization condition for images of inverse-system transition maps: for each i there exists j≥i such that all later images at i coincide. This is a Mittag-Leffler property of systems of sets and is not the tensor-comparison Mittag-Leffler property of modules.
